title: My Favourite Day
description: Practise the present simple and linking words, and invite a friend to share your favourite day.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with one thing: my favourite day is Saturday.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: On Saturdays I ___ (not / go) to school.
answers: don't go
do not go
exercises.explanation: With I, you, we and they, make the negative with don't (do not) + base verb: I don't go.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like Saturday because there is no school.
Because there is no school, I like Saturday.
exercises.explanation: "Because" gives the reason: I like Saturday because there is no school.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We goes to the park in the afternoon.
answers: We go to the park in the afternoon.
exercises.explanation: With we, the verb has no -s: we go.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I love ___ pancakes with my dad.
exercises.explanation: After love, like and hate, use the -ing form: I love making pancakes.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with and, but or because.
exercises.text: I like Sunday, ___ I don't like Sunday evening.
answers: but
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two opposite ideas: I like Sunday, but I don't like Sunday evening.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Saturdays.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I can to stay up late on Saturday.
answers: I can stay up late on Saturday.
exercises.explanation: After "can", use the verb without "to": I can stay up.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: On Saturdays my mum ___ (make) a big breakfast.
answers: makes
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, add -s to the verb: my mum makes.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like watching films with my family.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: I like watching films.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "his" before a noun to show that something belongs to a boy or man: his friends.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are a big market in my town on Saturday.
answers: There is a big market in my town on Saturday.
There's a big market in my town on Saturday.
exercises.explanation: Use "there is" (there's) with one thing: there is a market.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We have ___ picnic in the park.
exercises.explanation: Use "a" before a consonant sound: a picnic.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of be.
exercises.text: My brothers ___ (be) at home on Sunday.
answers: are
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with plural nouns: my brothers are.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We have got a lot of free time.
Have we got a lot of free time?
exercises.explanation: Subject + have got + noun: We have got a lot of free time.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Do your dad work on Saturday?
answers: Does your dad work on Saturday?
exercises.explanation: Use "Does" in questions with he, she and it: Does your dad work?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There is no school, ___ I can sleep late.
exercises.explanation: Use "so" to give a result: there is no school, so I can sleep late.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We watch two film in the evening.
answers: We watch two films in the evening.
exercises.explanation: After a number bigger than one, add -s to the noun: two films.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I can meet my friends in the afternoon.
In the afternoon I can meet my friends.
Can I meet my friends in the afternoon?
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + verb: I can meet my friends.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
answers: at
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times: at one o'clock.

task.prompt: Write a message to invite a friend to spend your favourite day with you.
contentPoints: Say which day is your favourite and why.
Say what you do on that day.
Invite your friend and give a time and place to meet.
task.modelAnswer:
Hi Ana,

Saturday is my favourite day because there is no school. In the morning I make pancakes with my dad. In the afternoon we go to the park. Can you come with us this Saturday? Meet me at my house at ten o'clock.

Ben
